target: acceptance 6 — a blocking failure must PREVENT specd. Prose in skills/spec binds only an agent that reads it; the tracker must refuse.
cmd: mkdir -p s; cp "$FIXTURES/spec-consistency/dup_numbers.md" s/920-bad.md; cp "$FIXTURES/spec-consistency/clean.md" s/921-ok.md; sed -i.bak "s/^status: queued/status: queued/" s/920-bad.md 2>/dev/null || true; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance s/920-bad.md specd >/dev/null 2>&1; bad=$?; st=$(grep -m1 "^status:" s/920-bad.md | sed "s/status: //"); "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance s/921-ok.md specd >/dev/null 2>&1; ok=$?; st2=$(grep -m1 "^status:" s/921-ok.md | sed "s/status: //"); printf '{"badRc":%s,"badStatus":"%s","okRc":%s,"okStatus":"%s"}' "$bad" "$st" "$ok" "$st2"
